summary: The terminal UI remembers content destinations across spaces, with back/forward navigation and Enter to attach detached terminals.

schema.detail: No database schema change; device-local workspace format 3 adds bounded navigation history and still reads formats 1 and 2.

compatibility.detail: Ctrl+[ and Ctrl+] navigate with enhanced keyboard input. Legacy Ctrl+5 goes forward. Leader [ and ] navigate on all terminals. Attached programs keep direct chords; Enter attaches detached terminal panes.
